newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Eng to buy real estate from Kia.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Eng to buy real estate from Kia.

text.p: Hyundai Engineering and Construction Co has agreed to buy a tract of land valued at about 80 billion won from Kisan Co, a unit of the troubled Kia Group, a Kia Group spokesman said on Saturday.
"The land has been on sale as part of our group's self-rescue measures," he said. "Kisan had originally planned to build and sell apartments on the land."

The Kia Group, South Korea's eighth-largest conglomerate, is in financial trouble with some 9.5 trillion won in debts and has said it would sell off part of its affiliates and real estate to raise cash.
Kia's flagship is automaker Kia Motors Corp.
